title: ReviewsSignalRemovedPayload
description: reviews.signal.removed v1 (OpenVibe.Reviews server/reviews/service.js withdrawSignal → signalEvent). A signal stopped being active, in the transaction of the change. status superseded: a newer revision of the same item replaced it for the same entity (replaced_by names the new signal, whose reviews.signal.added follows). status withdrawn: its source removed the item (sources.item.removed or a removed item on import), the item no longer states a signal, or an editor reattributed or unresolved the item. The payload repeats the signal as recorded (values and provenance never change) plus status and reason; summaries citing it are flagged and get a pending revision, and the entity's aggregate and Search document are refreshed, in the same transaction. Envelope: subject { type: signal, id: <signal_id> }, visibility public, priority important, actor the caller (the importing service, e.g. service:sources-sync, or the editor, user usr_…) or service:reviews for the Sources event consumer and sync worker.

entity_id.description: The entity the signal is attributed to (never rewritten by a merge).

canonical_entity_id.description: The entity it counted under: entity_id, or the entity it is merged into.

item_revision.description: The Sources item revision the signal was read from.

observed_at.description: When Sources retrieved that item revision (provenance.retrieved_at).

source_published_at.description: The item's published_at as Sources gave it; null when it gave none.

canonical_url.description: The item's canonical URL as Sources gave it; null when it has none.

license_note.description: Licence note recorded for the item in Sources; null when none.

recommended.description: recommendation only: whether the reviewer recommends it.

positive_count.description: recommendation_tally only: positive reviews the source counts.

total_count.description: recommendation_tally only: all reviews the source counts (≥ positive_count).

rating_value.description: rating and rating_aggregate only: the value as stated.

rating_best.description: rating and rating_aggregate only: top of the stated scale; null when the source states none.

rating_worst.description: rating and rating_aggregate only: bottom of the stated scale; null when the source states none.

rating_count.description: rating and rating_aggregate only: ratings behind the value (1 for a single review).

status.description: superseded: replaced by a newer revision of the same item; withdrawn: every other removal.

reason.description: Why, in plain words (e.g. "removed by its source: <reason>", "source item revised (r1 → r2)").

replaced_by.description: status superseded only: the signal that replaced it.
